abst.verdict_text.value: No operating point can safely auto-accept Compliant predictions. On non-held-out rows the most LOW predictions that can be accepted with zero false-compliant is 4 (exact 95% upper bound on the false-compliant rate 52.7%); the safety rule (upper bound <= 10%) needs at least 29 such acceptances with zero errors. The conservative point therefore switches compliant acceptance off (compliant_floor = 1.0).
